licenseNotices.note: Retain this attribution with catalog-derived facts. Application MIT licensing does not remove the source attribution requirement.

Mission statements are original concise paraphrases of linked agency, operator and manufacturer evidence. Source articles and the SpaceX PDF retain their publishers’ copyrights; no blanket open license is asserted.
Existing saved GP input is used for identity matching and the recorded sky. This library does not supply a new orbital feed.

axes.specificity: 0–2: concrete mission evidence; a family fact is not individually unique

selectionGuidance: Prioritize exceptional, then cool, among eligible visible satellites.
Deduplicate by storyId and vary familyId before repeating a constellation.
Treat context as object details; routine mass/size does not drive discovery priority.
Keep constellation or family framing, historic dates, design wording and estimate qualifiers.
applicableNoradIds contains only the exact recorded-frame subset; future feeds require a new identity/generation review.

sourceSnapshots.license: Publisher copyright; source evidence retained for research, no blanket open license asserted.

limits: Independent agents checked evidence and wording, not independent physical measurements.
Shared profiles expand coverage without being counted as unique anecdotes for every spacecraft.
Saved October2026 sky is not a live location-visibility or operational-health claim.
